content.rendered:
Chan Romero was only 17 when he wrote his breakthrough hit, “Hippy Hippy Shake.”

Released in 1959, it became a huge hit and caught the ear of Paul McCartney, who would perform it often during early Beatles gigs.

Three decades later, Bruce took his one and only swing at it when he made an unannounced guest appearance (along with Max Weinberg) on guitar with cover band Stand and Deliver at the Classics Cafe in Westwood, New Jersey. Take a listen below.

Hippy Hippy Shake
First performed: August 26, 1994 (Westfield, NJ)
Last performed: August 26, 1994 (Westfield, NJ)

© September 26, 2018

excerpt.rendered: From the Legends of Springsteen files: Bruce and Max join cover band Stand and Deliver at the Classics Cafe in Westwood for rocking rendition of “Hippy Hippy Shake.”

jetpack-related-posts.title: Slow Down
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: One time only: Bruce covers Larry Williams' influential "Slow Down" with a cover band at the Classics Cafe in Westwood, New Jersey.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Tobacco Road
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: One time only (that was recorded, anyway): Bruce, Max, and Tim McLoone cover John D. Loudermilk's "Tobacco Road."

jetpack-related-posts.title: Long Tall Sally
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Lots of times with lots of people: "Long Tall Sally" is tried and true when Bruce joins fellow musicians for an impromptu jam. Check out some of his best performances inside.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Jambalaya (On the Bayou)
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: At an impromptu soundcheck-turned-preshow, Bruce, Southside, and friends play a loose, fun cover of a Hank Williams classic.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Suspicious Minds
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Bruce joins a stellar line-up of guest musicians at a 1994 John Eddie concert to cover Elvis Presley's last number one hit, "Suspicious Minds."

jetpack-related-posts.title: Funky Broadway
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: One time only: Bruce joins short-lived Stone Pony house band The Shots for a cover of Wilson Pickett's hit, "Funky Broadway."
